en: The image depicts an old sepia-toned photograph of a building partially obscured by several trees. The building appears to be of European architectural style and has visible signage with text in a foreign language (possibly Danish or Germanic). There are a few people standing near the entrance of the building. The postcard has a vintage appearance, suggesting it was produced in the early 20th century.
